name: DeepL
tagline: DeepL is widely regarded as the most accurate AI translation service available, producing natural-sounding translations that preserve tone and nuance better than competitors. It supports 33 languages and offers a document translation feature that maintains the original formatting. DeepL Pro is popular with businesses and translators who need consistent quality for sensitive or technical content.
